entities.name: Geoffrey Lawrence, 1st Baron Oaksey

entities.summary: Geoffrey Lawrence, 3rd Baron Trevethin, 1st Baron Oaksey, was the lead British judge during the Nuremberg trials after Second World War, and President of the International Military Tribunal.
